headlines.title: Cornell students protest handling of alleged 2024 sexual assault
headlines.description: Students at Cornell University are protesting on campus over the handling of the alleged 2024 sexual assault. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa spoke with a sophomore who is calling for the resignation of administrators.

headlines.title: After bipartisan criticism, Trump says taxpayers’ dollars will no longer be used for TV ads promoting him
headlines.description: The president said the ads, which the White House has defended, will be funded by him and his super PAC, MAGA Inc.

headlines.title: Trump uses anti-trans slur against Democratic Senate candidate in South Carolina
headlines.description: Annie Andrews is a physician running against Sen. Darline Graham.

headlines.title: 3 takeaways from our new poll of Latino voters: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Trump Rallies for Republicans Ahead of Midterm Elections
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is making a major push in once-reliable Republican states as a new NBC News poll shows his party could be facing an uphill battle ahead of the midterm elections. It comes as new Trump ads, paid for by taxpayers, get prime-time air, some during football games. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Televangelist Jim Bakker dies at age 86
headlines.description: Jim Bakker, the televangelist who rose to fame with the PTL network in the 1970s, but was later convicted of fraud and conspiracy, has died at the age of 86.

headlines.title: Mystery death in Russian lab
headlines.description: U.S. officials are closely monitoring a situation in Russia after a woman died last week. Authorities say she worked at a lab that studied the plague. NBC News’ Anne Thompson has the story.

headlines.title: Supreme Court hears arguments in climate change case seeking to hold companies liable
headlines.description: The Supreme Court began its new term by hearing arguments in a case seeking to hold energy companies liable for damages caused by climate change. NBC News' Gary Grumbach has details on the cases presented and potential implications.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S. bombers pulled from British base due to threats
headlines.description: The U.S. military moved all its bombers from RAF Fairford in part because of the threat of a possible Iranian drone attack against the base and the aircraft, according to two U.S. officials. NBC News’ Courtney Kube reports.

headlines.title: Aiming at fuel costs, Trump opens tax-exempt ‘red dye’ diesel to all drivers
headlines.description: Trump signed an executive order intended to help bring down sky-high diesel prices by allowing anyone to purchase tax-exempt “red dye” diesel.

headlines.title: Former ‘American Idol’ contestant sentenced to life in prison for wife’s murder
headlines.description: Caleb Flynn broke down in tears in court as his daughters’ victim impact statements were read aloud, as he continues to maintain his innocence. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports.

headlines.title: Live updates: The absolute best October Prime Day deals, hand-picked by a shopping reporter
headlines.description: NBC Selected editors are tracking the best October Prime Day deals live, with prices and recommendations updated throughout the event. Here’s what’s worth buying.
